metadata.publisher: Gleislicht, derived from SBB and official Luzern open data
metadata.dayModel: civil day with preceding service-day spillover
metadata.label: Luzern canton — admitted complete stop patterns
metadata.model: scheduled interpolation along official alignments and inferred OSM bus roads
metadata.note: Complete directed stop patterns only, with every segment passing identity, projection, connectivity and detour checks. Retain every original source call. Official geometry takes precedence; failed bus pairs may use pinned OSM road inference only when every complete pattern context agrees. Geometry is inferred, not certified street direction, track assignment or observed vehicle movement.
metadata.scope: Every annual GTFS trip with at least one source stop inside the complete official Luzern polygon, across every agency and mode. Fixture trips retain every source call, including cross-canton termini. No straight-line crossing test for nonstopping through traffic.
exclusions: Annual GTFS membership is a census of the pinned archive, not proof that all real-world or demand-responsive services are represented.
Fixture validation covers Friday and Sunday plus preceding-day carry-in, not all annual seasonal, holiday or diversion patterns.
Services crossing the canton without a stop are outside the passenger-service scope.
No realtime data, one-way street certification or individual running-track validation.
